decisions.reason: Independently pretrained Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 multispectral representations; modality-specific stems, cross-attention fusion, dual centering. Complements RGB DINOv3/SigLIP2/SAM3 for lawful environmental and crop classification; not a general VLM or quantization duplicate.
decisions.reconstruction: Original learned state cannot be recovered from code or generic vision weights; 18.7M Sentinel tiles publisher training claim. Exact tensor count, full local environment and task heads unverified.

validation_design.H: Under matched local compute and geographic splits, TerraFM B with frozen encoder adds lawful environmental classification utility unavailable in RGB-only incumbent input paths.
validation_design.T: At least 100 lawful public held-out tiles per stratum and geographically disjoint train/test; matched RGB projection vs sensor-specific input; same supervised head budget, seeds, host CPU/GPU/clock, PyTorch version, batch=1 latency and memory; no actual inference in this round.
validation_design.D: PASS if paired geographic-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for task macro-F1 difference >= -2 percentage points and at least one sensor-only task is supported with complete local restore; FAIL if upper bound < -2 points or unsupported local restore; otherwise UNCERTAIN. These are proposed thresholds, not measured.
validation_design.C: RGB baseline may suffice; sensor coverage mismatch, poor regional transfer, missing band order, invalid L2A/L1C preprocessing, unknown exact tensor count and head availability.
validation_design.U: Geographic autocorrelation, label noise, seed, CPU/GPU and sampling variance; combined uncertainty not estimable until measurement.
